zh-CN.title: 无智亦无得
zh-CN.subtitle: 《心经》关于知识与所得的段落
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这句经文适合引导观众区分“无所得”的经文语境与现代语境中的知识否定。
curatorialDescription: 本馆将这句放在《心经》整体结构中，不把它剪裁成脱离经文的励志格言。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充版本定位、句读和不同注疏对“智”“得”的解释。

en.title: No wisdom and no attainment
en.subtitle: A Heart Sutra passage on knowing and attaining
en.shortSummary: The line invites a distinction between the sutra's context of non-attainment and a modern denial of knowledge.
curatorialDescription: The museum keeps the line within the Heart Sutra's structure instead of turning it into a context-free motivational maxim.
en.researchNote: Version locator, punctuation and commentarial interpretations of wisdom and attainment still need to be added.
